easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
description:
Activate Myr Welder using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
If Voltaic Construct is on the battlefield, activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder. Otherwise, activate Myr Welder using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
